tasks.description: Add root SKILL.md detection as 5th discovery strategy in discoverSkills(). Only runs if strategies 1-4 found 0 skills. Reads frontmatter for name (fallback: basename). Sets relativePath to ".".
steps: discoverSkills() on a dir with only root SKILL.md returns 1 skill
Skill name comes from frontmatter name: field when present
Skill name falls back to directory basename when no frontmatter name
relativePath is "."
Root SKILL.md is NOT discovered if strategies 1-4 already found skills

tasks.description: Repo-as-skill installs correctly via simba install, including all subdirs (references/, scripts/, prompts/, templates/). installSource.skillPath stored as "." in registry.
steps: simba install on a local repo-as-skill source installs the skill
Entire directory including references/ and scripts/ subdirs is copied
installSource.skillPath is "." in registry
--skill flag works with repo-as-skill
--all flag works with repo-as-skill

tasks.description: simba update re-discovers and updates root skills via relativePath === "." matching.
steps: simba update re-discovers root skill after re-cloning
Matches on relativePath === "."
Directory hash comparison detects changes in any file

tasks.description: Unit tests for root skill discovery, install with subdirs, relativePath, and deduplication guard.
steps: Test: discovers skill from root SKILL.md
Test: name from frontmatter
Test: name fallback to basename
Test: relativePath is "."
Test: root SKILL.md skipped when standard dirs have skills (dedup)
Test: install copies references/ and scripts/ subdirs
Test: installSource.skillPath is "."
All tests pass

nonGoals: SKILL.md at arbitrary depth without skills/ parent
